title: fix(app-shell): the translation preview draws the positions and permissions groups, at an objectstack pin that declares them (objectui#13478)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DSu9uoz6bLHskQmxnyBE86T)_

Fixes #13478
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

objectstack's `Console Pin Gate` is red on main because app-shell no longer type-checks against objectstack `47af3dde42` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25701). That change added the `positions` and `permissions` groups to the per-app `TranslationDataSchema`, and `TranslationPreview`'s `CATEGORY_DEFS` is exhaustive over that schema's shape by `satisfies`. This PR adds the two rows and moves objectui's own pin to `47af3dde42`, so objectui type-checks against the same spec. Once it merges, objectstack can move its `.objectui-sha` past the merge commit (objectstack's own card names this one as its blocker).

## What changed

- **`TranslationPreview.tsx`**: two `CATEGORY_DEFS` rows, in the schema's order (after `flows`, before `metadataForms`): `positions` with `Users` and `permissions` with `ShieldCheck`, the icons `PositionPreview` and `PermissionPreview` already draw. Both are nested groups (`flat: false`), so each card counts the group's top-level keys and samples them with their inner key count, as `objects` and `flows` do.
- **`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`** (the designer table, the only pack these keys live in, `en` and `zh`): `engine.translationPreview.category.positions` = "Positions" / "岗位" and `engine.translationPreview.category.permissions` = "Permission Sets" / "权限集", the words the same table already uses for the two metadata types.
- **Tests**: `TranslationPreview.categories-11765.test.tsx` gets a spec-valid fixture for each new group (its first case requires one per schema group). `adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2.test.tsx` lists the two headings among the rendered locale sites and reads coverage over 13 groups (`2/13 (15%)`, was `2/11 (18%)`).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/13478-translation-preview-positions-permissions.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## The pin

- `.objectstack-sha` moves from `e649c2d91e` (the 18.1.0 release commit) to `47af3dde42bb4e77fd92025605b89b4a473295a4`. REST compare `e649c2d91e...47af3dde42`: `status: ahead`, `ahead_by: 51`, `behind_by: 0`; the bump script also reported "(on origin/main)". It is pinned at the card's floor, not at objectstack main's head: the four commits after it on objectstack main are left for the next bump.
- Path: `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh 47af3dde42bb4e77fd92025605b89b4a473295a4 --no-commit` (built and packed the 7 packages), then `pnpm install`.
- What moved besides the sha: three packed manifests in `.objectstack-pin/` (`core`, `lint`, `spec`), each only `zod` `^4.6.5` to `^4.6.6` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25657). The lockfile already resolves `zod@4.6.7`, so **`pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged** and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0.
- **Why the rows and the pin land together** (the seat's hypothesis; it held). At `e649c2d91e` the schema declares neither group: `grep -c '^  positions: z.record'` over that commit's `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` reads 0, and 1 at `47af3dde42`; the same for `permissions`. Under `satisfies`, an extra key in an object literal is TS2353 "Object literal may only specify known properties" (probed with this repo's tsc 6.0.3 on a two-key `Record`). So the rows alone fail at the old pin, and the pin alone fails as the gate does.

## Clause-② reading (the claim asked for it)

The claim declares `yes` because the seat could not tell whether `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` reaches app-shell's published entry, and the two lines above are copied from the claim. Measured on the built declaration closure (`packages/app-shell/dist`, walking the relative imports from `index.d.ts`, the only `exports` entry with types):

- The closure holds 182 `.d.ts` files. `views/metadata-admin/i18n.d.ts` **is** one of them (the positive control), but its face is `t(key: string, …)`, `tFormat(key: string, …)` and the other helpers: the key table is not exported, and no key is a type.
- Closure files that carry the string `translationPreview`: **0**. `previews/TranslationPreview.d.ts` is not in the closure at all.

So the diff widens no published accept set and no public face of app-shell, and the reading is `no`. The declaration is the seat's, so the lines stay as claimed.

## Verification (local, this worktree, at the new pin)

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --concurrency=2` (under the verify lock, 6144 MB heap): 35 of 35 tasks, including `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `tsc` and the console's vite build, SDUI manifest and plugin tsc. That is the build the Console Pin Gate runs, here at objectui's own pin.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ packages/types/` (under the lock): 980 files passed; 17091 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- The three TranslationPreview test files: 63 of 63. Reverse check: with the two rows removed from `TranslationPreview.tsx` (on-disk count 0, back to 2 after the restore), the `categories-11765` file goes red on its order-and-coverage case and on every per-group case, the two new groups included.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, and `eslint` on the four changed source files.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1 with the same two `floor-too-low` findings (`@object-ui/auth` `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_EXTERNAL`, `@object-ui/types` `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource`) that #13472 recorded as pre-existing on main. This diff touches neither package. The gate runs on push and schedule with `--cross-check`, which is its measurement, and that run is green on main `cd70b78`.

NOT MEASURED locally (left to CI): the rest of the workspace `vitest` shards, `lint` and `type-check` across all packages, and e2e.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui#13477 (the label render of the same objectstack change) is a different defect; it remains open and nothing here touches it.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
